summary: Approved for the explicitly fixed exact-inner-solve St(2,1) specialization of ManPQN: all 120 scalar coordinates independently reconstructed at 70 decimal digits match. The result cannot be generalized to rejection of valid inexact ASSN directions.

cases.reason: The independent calculation projects smooth gradients, forms Euclidean secants of Riemannian gradients, applies the 0.25/0.75 damping rule with delta*I restart and one retained pair, and uses only diag(B) in the metric. The tangent direction is solved globally as a one-dimensional piecewise quadratic plus absolute-value problem; normalization gives polar retraction. Every minimal Armijo backtracking exponent and all recorded states match.
citations: PDF pp.20-21 numerical inner-loop cap and SVD retraction

scope_notes: The fixture deliberately fixes exact minimization of (3.6). The numerical procedure describes ASSN with a finite inner-iteration cap and refers elsewhere for details; the PDF does not uniquely fix every practical inner stopping choice.

A trajectory mismatch produced by a permitted inexact inner solve alone is not sufficient evidence of a general ManPQN algorithm error. An adapter must either supply the explicitly requested exact specialization without replacing the optimizer or report this limitation.

Only St(2,1), memory one, Euclidean secant approximation (not transported equation (3.5)), and the stated nonmonotone window are approved; higher rank, larger memory, ASSN internals and convergence rates are untested.
All results meet frozen atol=1e-9 and rtol=1e-8; no private values or tolerances changed.
